architectureDecisions: Keep the exact BB-060/061 ports: pullBackendFiles(parsedOrder,{repositoryReader}) calls repositoryReader.readFile({repositoryRef,revision,path}); pullQaArtifacts(parsedOrder,{artifactReader}) calls artifactReader.readArtifact({ref,path,producerWorkOrderId,revision,acceptanceDecision}). Do not rename or unify them.

packages/oracle owns ordered port calls, source-boundary error wrapping and plain result assembly. Application owns parsing/final ContextSchema validation plus reader/client construction, endpoints, credentials, transport lifetime and direct injection.

Repository bytes remain an external versioned source. Accepted application artifacts remain internal; createManifestArtifactReader(...).forManifest(manifestRef) stays an Application-owned validating decorator before Oracle and preserves producer/revision/acceptance identity.

No production SCM/MCP reader exists at baseline. Do not ship a filesystem reader unable to honor arbitrary repositoryRef/revision or an MCP reader based on an invented universal URI. Deliver executable direct-injection topology tests and honest Living Docs.

A future named MCP repository adapter may implement readFile using resources/read only. Application pins server identity, auth, transport and a server-specific request-to-URI mapping; sourceRef binds server and URI. Oracle owns no tools, Tasks, subscriptions, protocol ids, retries or connection lifecycle.

Failures are fail-closed: parsing precedes IO; adapter failures preserve cause and receive exact repositoryRef@revision/path or artifact-ref context; schema failure precedes Worker; no partial Context or silent fallback.
Worker requires BB-061 DONE and verifies its receipt delivers the exact ports and Application -> Oracle direction. Material mismatch is PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION, not permission to broaden BB-062.
implementationSlices: O31 — Gate on BB-061 DONE; verify its receipt, exact functions, thin Application adapters and dependency direction against dependencyContract or stop with PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION.

O34 — Extend architecture tests to keep fixed ports distinct, Application-owned composition explicit, packages/oracle free of MCP SDK/Application/Core imports and provider/lifecycle authority, and error cause/context intact.
O35 — Update Living Oracle/Application docs to the tested topology, explicitly state no production repository/MCP adapter exists, and document the future named-server resources/read contract.
O36 — Run Oracle/connectivity/manifest/boundary/Agentic regressions and bind criterion evidence to exact outputs and source/doc anchors.
